name: Write detailed creative fiction scenes
description: Users asked the AI to write creative fiction scenes, often based on existing media franchises or original concepts, with specific instructions regarding character dynamics, settings, and plot points. Many of these requests featured minors, elaborate fetishistic scenarios involving bodily functions, messes, or disability, and required detailed descriptive narratives of unusual or sensory-heavy events.
